sessions.prompt:
Add parse_date(s) to dates.py: an ISO date string such as "2026-06-05" becomes a datetime.date. Add tests.

The plan for parse_date has one more step: it also accepts day/month/year dates ("05/06/2026" is 5 June 2026). Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): room numbers are positive whole numbers: adding a room with another number, or with a number the hotel already has, raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: a stay is at least 1 night: a booking whose end date is not after its start date raises ValueError.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_date(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept day/month/year dates.
decisions: Room numbers are positive whole numbers; another number or a duplicate raises ValueError.
A stay is at least 1 night: an end date not after the start raises ValueError.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Hotel class to hotel.py: add_room(number, kind, price) adds a room of kind "single" or "double" with a nightly price in int cents, book(guest, kind, start, end) books a free room of that kind for the nights from start up to end (dates) and returns a booking id (1, 2, 3 and so on), and room_of(booking_id) returns the booked room number. When no room of that kind is free, book raises ValueError. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): guest names ignore case in every function: "Ann" and "ANN" are the same guest.

Design decision for this project: Friday and Saturday nights cost 20% more than the room's nightly price.

Design decision for this project: the stay line of a confirmation has the form Room 12, 3 nights.

given.handoff: Session 2 added Hotel.add_room, book and room_of with tests.
decisions: Guest names ignore case in every function.
Friday and Saturday nights cost 20% more than the nightly price.
A confirmation stay line has the form Room 12, 3 nights.

sessions.prompt:
Add Hotel.cancel(booking_id) to hotel.py. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): Friday and Saturday nights cost 25% more, not 20%.

Design decision for this project: two bookings of the same room may not overlap; a stay that ends on the day another starts does not overlap it.

Design decision for this project: book gives the free room of that kind with the lowest number.

decisions: Supersedes 20%: Friday and Saturday nights cost 25% more.
Bookings of the same room may not overlap; ending on the day another starts is not an overlap.
book gives the free room of that kind with the lowest number.

sessions.prompt:
Add Hotel.free_rooms(start, end) to hotel.py: the sorted numbers of the rooms that are free for all nights from start up to end. Add tests.

The plan for Hotel.free_rooms has one more step: it takes an optional kind and then returns only rooms of that kind. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): a stay is at least 2 nights: a booking of fewer nights raises ValueError.

given.handoff: Session 4 added Hotel.free_rooms(start, end) with tests. Its last step is left for later: an optional kind.
decisions: Supersedes 1 night: a stay is at least 2 nights; fewer raises ValueError.
